sentences.en: Gina's sheer coldness attracted scads of men with low self-esteem.
sentences.zh: 吉娜那股冷淡劲儿吸引了许多自尊心低下的男人。

sentences.en: Why do so many people suffer from low self-esteem?
sentences.zh: 为什么会有那么多人患有自尊心低下症？

sentences.en: People with low self-esteem tend to interpret everything in a negative way.
sentences.zh: 自尊心低下的人往往会以消极的方式看待一切。
